posts.title: Unity in Christ Jesus
posts.description: Dearest brother who is at war, You probably have gotten so used to it that you forgot. I forget this sometimes myself, that we are at war. In these moments, this verse awakens my soul to remembering that …our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms

posts.title: remain soft
posts.description: Dearest brother, I pray your heart and soul be softened by love and remain soft for eternity. I pray you know that softness is beauty, strength, power and authority surpassing the understanding of the world; for when you are soft, you are patient, kind, compassionate, merciful, and forgiving. posts.title: To my artistic brother, the sanctuary constructor
posts.description: Dearest brother, If you are artistic in any way, shape or form, will you consider it sacred? If you like making anything, creating anything, absorbing (reading, listening, watching etc) anything and find joy in these activities, I believe it is a sacred essence that makes you like our Father - one of many things about you that's included in the "made in the image of God" package.
